$comment: Curated. What the names in contributing/inventory/data can't say about the move to the next major. `components` overrides a 2.x component by stack: `canonical` (its manifest, when component-map.json's has none), `to` (its new name), `keep` (the name stands), `children` (its props belong to a child the manifest doesn't describe, so they aren't checked against it), `manual` with `note` (reported wherever it is used), `add` (attributes the new component needs). `props` lists member rules by manifest name (`*` for every component that has the member); they win over the rules derived from api-aliases.json. `kind: keep` means the member carries over; with a `note` it is listed in the guides as unchanged. `kind: duration` turns a `250ms` or `1s` literal into integer milliseconds. `evidence` says where the rule comes from. Run `npm run rules` after editing.
